source_excerpt:
Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board (UPPRPB) , has released the Final Marks on its official website for the recruitment of UP Home Guard Posts. The DV / PST exam was conducted from 13 July to 07 August 2026, and the last date to submit the application form was 17 December 2025. Candidates will able to check their Final Result using their Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth by logging into the portal.

UPPRPB provides age relaxation for the Police Home Guard position as per their regulations.
Candidate must have passed Class 10th or an equivalent qualification from a recognized board. Candidates employed in government, semi-government, or public sector organizations are not eligible to apply. Applicants must also have their 10th marksheet and certificate available at the time of application.

Click on the “UP Police Home Guard Final Result 2026” link available on the homepage.
